name: Deploy Cloudflare Worker

# Deploy Worker otomatis setiap ada perubahan di folder worker/ pada branch main.
# Butuh repo secrets: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN dan CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.
# Kalau lebih suka deploy manual (`npx wrangler deploy`), file ini bisa dihapus.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "worker/**"
      - "wrangler.toml"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-worker.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy dengan Wrangler
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          # wrangler.toml ada di root repo, jadi deploy jalan dari root
          command: deploy
